construct.name: education-sector relevance
construct.note: Vocabulary derived from ERIC Thesaurus, UNESCO Thesaurus, and ISCED. Recommended gate roles reflect application to a heterogeneous AI-governance corpus, not the controlled vocabularies' own indexing rules.

selection_principles: Standalone anchors explicitly denote educational systems, levels, institutions, actors, pedagogical constructs, education governance, or education-specific technologies.
Context-dependent terms are valid education concepts but have common noneducation senses in AI-governance text and should not independently establish education relevance.
Workforce/capacity terms are descriptive tags only so their prevalence can be measured rather than built into corpus selection.
Higher-education research-only terms are treated cautiously because a university or professor can be mentioned in a research role without the chunk governing education.
